# Vishnu Roshan

> Senior Software Engineer with eight years building full-stack web and mobile products across healthcare, e-commerce, logistics, and HR technology. Recent work spans retrieval and LLM systems in TypeScript, React, Node.js, and Python.

## About

- Based in Chennai, India.
- Languages: TypeScript, JavaScript, Python.
- Frontend: React, Next.js, React Native, PWAs, Responsive design, Accessibility (a11y), Web performance, SEO.
- Backend & Data: Node.js, Express.js, REST APIs, GraphQL, WebSockets, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Redis, pgvector, Celery, RabbitMQ.
- Cloud & Delivery: AWS, Cloudflare, Docker, Jenkins, CI/CD.
- Testing: Jest, Vitest, Playwright.
- AI Engineering: LiteLLM, Vector search, Hybrid search, Claude Code, AI-assisted development.
- Architecture & Practice: Microservices, System design, Clean architecture, Design patterns, Project leadership.
- Design: UX Design, Interaction Design (IxD), Design systems, Figma.

## Experience

- **Senior Software Engineer**, Sedin Technologies — Railsfactory Division, Chennai (Jan 2023 - Present). Software Engineer, Oct 2020 - Jan 2023. Delivered 10–12 client projects across healthcare, e-commerce, publishing, warehouse management, HR technology, management consulting, and retail analytics; led three frontend and backend engineers on a recent project. Management consulting — migrated vector storage from ChromaDB to `pgvector`, folding search onto the existing database and enabling hybrid search over mixed prose and structured records with Reciprocal Rank Fusion, which the two-store setup could not support without overhead. Healthcare — built compliance tracking for a clinical workforce platform. HR technology — built an applicant tracking and assessment platform for candidates and hiring teams. Retail analytics — built a React Native app using computer vision to read product insights from shelf photography. Sedstart — cut render times on Sedin's in-house end-to-end testing product by restructuring its React render tree.
- **Software Engineer**, Teknuance Info Solutions, Chennai (Jul 2019 - Jun 2020). Built REST APIs in Node.js over PostgreSQL and MongoDB for data-heavy applications. Developed progressive web apps, including D-Sci, an end-to-end analytics platform. Owned and maintained Olimium, a real-time chat application built on WebSockets. Applied design patterns and Twelve-Factor App practice to keep services modular and cloud-ready.
- **Full Stack Developer**, Bionworks Technologies (now part of IQVIA), Chennai (May 2018 - Jun 2019). Built and maintained Healthcommand, a secure family health record application, on Node.js with Angular 6 and Ionic 3. Contributed core modules to Healthplug MD, a mobile-first EMR for physicians and care teams, and to PX, a patient engagement platform.
- **Software Engineer Intern**, Aosta Software Solutions, Coimbatore (Dec 2017 - May 2018). Android app for inpatient workflows, in Java and the Android SDK.

## Playground

- [Zero Hero](https://zerohero.vishnuroshan.in/): Reach exactly zero before the timer runs out. React, TypeScript, and Vite, built for the GMTK Game Jam 2026.
- [Lovedoku](https://lovedoku.vercel.app/): Ad-free Sudoku, built for my wife. Rewrote the generator around a Dancing Links exact-cover solver with technique-based difficulty grading, cutting hardest-level generation from ~1s to ~6ms.
- [Steam Lib](https://steamlib.vercel.app/): Browse and manage Steam game libraries. Next.js over the Steam and IGDB APIs, with a Postgres-backed metadata cache that fetches only uncached titles, in batches of 500.
- [tui-tac-toe](https://www.npmjs.com/package/tuitactoe): Tic Tac Toe in the terminal, built with Ink. Install with `npx tuitactoe`.
